column3: Most of you said: lie for him.
You look the soldier in the eye and say it. I'm family.
The door opens. Hundreds of people. Lights. Clean air.
Then a woman at the front desk stands up.
I'm Doctor Vale's wife. He has no brother.
As the door closes, Eli throws the case inside. Not for himself. For them.
Five seconds. He throws himself over you.
When the dust settles, you're alive. Eli doesn't answer.
In his hand, a note in someone else's handwriting.
Take my card. Save anyone you can.
Vale was never his brother. Just a stranger who gave him a chance.
Twenty-four hours later, the door opens again.
Those pills protected forty children last night.
Then your phone finds one bar of signal.
A man called me before it hit. He told me to get underground. He knew my name.
His one phone call. He used it on your sister.
Your lie nearly killed you both. His lie saved forty kids, and your sister.
Want to see what happens if you tell the truth? Comment truth, and follow for the next story.
